charts.title: WASP-100 b: orbits around WASP-100
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-100's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-100 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 2.84938272598 d

charts.title: WASP-100 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-100 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 97, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 38846515, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
